upstream.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.

classification.analysis: OpenMontage is an open-source library of 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files (plus 100+ tools across 12 pipelines) that turns an existing AI coding assistant (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Windsurf) into a full video production studio, orchestrating research, scripting, image/video generation (Flux, Kling, Veo, Stable Diffusion), voice/TTS (ElevenLabs), music, and Remotion-based composition from a plain-language prompt. It includes a local "Backlot" web board for live production status, scene-by-scene approval gates, and per-video cost tracking, and can also start from a reference video (YouTube/TikTok) to reverse-engineer a production plan. A fast-growing project aimed at solo creators wanting AI-agent-driven video production without a traditional editing pipeline.

use_cases.title: Turn your coding assistant into a video production studio
Generate a short film from a text prompt with cost estimates
Recreate a reference YouTube or TikTok video's style with AI agents
Draw on a large real-world library of agent skill files for video tasks
